title: Trust v1 contract: principal, ACL, signature, output-chain, and lease vectors
goal:
Create docs/trust-auth-v1.md and test fixtures under docs/fixtures/trust-auth-v1/ implementing the exact decisions in campaign/research/prong-trust-codex.md: identifiers and grammars, P-256 key encodings, fixed-array signature transcript, operation schemas and maximum sizes, principal/global scopes, per-session ACL roles, channel open/accept, seq/expiry/replay rules, muxd output signature/hash chain, authoritative lease transitions, signed deferred-input delegation, capability names, error codes, and migration flags. Append every new host-link frame/capability to docs/protocol-fields.md without changing protocol 4. Add JS and Python conformance tests that independently reproduce the same transcript bytes, SHA-256 digests, accepted signatures, rejected one-byte mutations, and output-chain vectors.

Also write campaign/research/decisions/trust-model.md as the machine-owned decision record. Required single-line keys: RELAY_AUTHORITY, RELAY_UNTRUSTED_REASON, PRINCIPAL_KEY, ENROLLMENT, ENROLLMENT_BOOTSTRAP, ACL_STORE, OUTPUT_CONFIDENTIALITY, CONFIDENTIALITY_TRADEOFF, DOWNGRADE_POLICY, SIG_INPUT, INTERACTIVE_EXP_MS, and RESIDUAL_R1 through RESIDUAL_R8. Every RESIDUAL_Rn line must carry both a detect: clause and an accepted: clause; closed items use accepted:no plus closed-by evidence. RELAY_UNTRUSTED_REASON must name VPS multi-tenancy/same-host co-tenants. CONFIDENTIALITY_TRADEOFF must state that relay-blind encryption deletes four value capabilities spanning r.2 children 6/7, 8, 10, and 16. ENROLLMENT_BOOTSTRAP must state why the local QR/pairing secret is out-of-band and why relay-mediated TOFU would let the relay enroll itself.
verifier: node --test --test-force-exit --test-timeout=20000 relay/tests/trust-auth-contract.test.js && timeout 60 python -m pytest muxd/tests/test_trust_auth_contract.py -q && python -c "p='campaign/research/decisions/trust-model.md';s=open(p,encoding='utf-8').read();ls=[x.strip() for x in s.splitlines() if x.strip()];req=['RELAY_AUTHORITY','RELAY_UNTRUSTED_REASON','PRINCIPAL_KEY','ENROLLMENT','ENROLLMENT_BOOTSTRAP','ACL_STORE','OUTPUT_CONFIDENTIALITY','CONFIDENTIALITY_TRADEOFF','DOWNGRADE_POLICY','SIG_INPUT','INTERACTIVE_EXP_MS'];assert all(any(x.startswith(k+':') for x in ls) for k in req);assert all(any(x.startswith(f'RESIDUAL_R{i}:') and 'detect:' in x.lower() and 'accepted:' in x.lower() for x in ls) for i in range(1,9))"

title: muxd identity + durable principal registry + pairing and per-session ACLs
goal:
Implement muxd's durable trust state: one P-256 instance identity and instanceId; principals.json with principal/key status, global scopes, revocation epochs and audit metadata; immutable random sessionUuid plus aclRevision and per-session ACL in the session manifest; pending one-time pairing grants with 256-bit secret, five-minute expiry, exact grants, single-use/idempotent replay semantics, HMAC registration proof, and muxd-identity-signed receipt. Extend muxctl with pair create/list, principal list/revoke, acl show/grant/revoke, and local claim for migrated sessions. Existing sessions start remote-deny until explicitly claimed. Private files are created with Ahmed/SYSTEM-only ACLs and never copied to relay state. Tests use temp state and fault injection to prove durable commit, restart, single-use pairing, no scope escalation, exact-replay idempotency, revocation persistence, immutable sessionUuid across rename/restart, and migrated-session deny-by-default.

BOOTSTRAP DISCIPLINE: the local muxctl QR carries the muxd identity fingerprint plus a one-time secret and fixed grant out of band. Registration may transit the relay, but the relay cannot choose the grant, know the secret, substitute its key, or make the client accept without an identity-signed receipt matching the physically transferred fingerprint. This is the load-bearing enrollment argument and must be tested with relay substitution and altered-grant negatives.
verifier: cd muxd && timeout 180 python -m pytest tests/test_principal_store.py tests/test_pairing.py tests/test_session_acl.py -q

title: Trusted web client origin: non-extractable signer, pairing, and origin lock
goal: Add relay/public/principal-auth.js and the build/deploy configuration for MUX_TRUSTED_CLIENT_ORIGIN, hosted outside the relay VPS. Generate a P-256 ECDSA key with extractable:false, persist the CryptoKey in IndexedDB only under the trusted origin, consume pairing data from the URL fragment, HMAC the exact registration body, verify muxd's signed receipt/fingerprint, clear pairing secrets from URL/history/memory, and expose only operation-specific signing methods. Refuse signing when location.origin differs from the pinned trusted origin. Add strict CSP/no-third-party/frame-ancestors-none headers to the published artifact. The relay-origin copy becomes read-only and redirects drive actions. Existing feature modules call the signer API rather than handling key material. Browser tests prove the private key cannot be exported, relay-origin code cannot load/use the key, pairing receipt tamper fails, and a valid trusted-origin frame matches trust-1 vectors. Add @playwright/test as a pinned relay devDependency and provision Chromium in the trusted-client test setup/deploy script; the verifier must never depend on npx downloading a package or browser interactively.
verifier: cd relay && npx --no-install playwright test tests/browser/trusted-client-auth.spec.js --reporter=line --timeout=60000

title: muxd principal-proof enforcement for every PC-side terminal mutation
goal:
Implement principalAuthV1 in muxd: signed channel.open and identity-signed channel.accept; bounded schema checks before crypto; P-256 signature verification; channel expiry; exact-next sequence with cached exact-duplicate ack and conflicting-seq close; body digest then operation-specific parse; per-frame principal/key/revocation/ACL checks; durable intent journal for durable and management operations. Require proof for input.raw, input.durable, resize, create, relaunch, kill, rename, heal, and ACL mutations. Add MUX_AUTHZ_MODE=audit|enforce for staged rollout, default audit until the migration leaf flips it; in enforce mode legacy relay t:'i' and proofless control frames return principal-proof-required without touching session state. The negative honesty test must assert a well-formed proofless input reaches muxd, is rejected there, and performs zero PTY writes.

SEQUENCING: local-control authentication and secret ACL hardening from trust leaf 9 land before this endpoint enforcement leaf, so the hostile relay cannot bypass the new boundary through the old loopback control port.
verifier: cd muxd && timeout 240 python -m pytest tests/test_principal_input_auth.py tests/test_principal_management_auth.py -q

title: muxd authoritative multi-viewer write lease with epoch-fenced steal
goal: Move write arbitration to muxd. Maintain holderPrincipalId/keyId/channelId, lastAcceptedInputMonotonic, and leaseEpoch per session. A signed holder input refreshes; a signed input may atomically acquire when free/stale after MUX_INPUT_LEASE_MS default 3000; a different fresh holder is rejected before PTY write with an identity-signed lease-held response; signed lease.steal by any drive-authorized principal transfers immediately; every acquisition/steal/revocation increments the epoch; old-epoch queued frames are rejected. Channel close, ACL/key/principal revocation, session restart, and explicit release clear correctly. Expose signed lease state for UI mirroring. Tests use two principals and two channels to prove no interleaving, stale acquire, explicit steal, delayed old-holder rejection, relay-forged holder metadata ignored, and revocation clearing the lease.
verifier: cd muxd && timeout 180 python -m pytest tests/test_authorized_write_lease.py -q

title: Relay principal-auth conduit: forward proofs unchanged and mint no PC authority
goal: Update relay/server.js and the trusted client wiring so channel/authz frames and signed muxd receipts pass through unchanged. /api/sessions/:name/send accepts one already signed input.durable envelope, validates only transport bounds, forwards exact bytes, and correlates the signed muxd result; it never constructs principalId, keyId, intentId, signature, lease epoch, or text body. Browser raw input, paste, keybar, mouse click, resize, composer, and quick replies all use principal-auth.js. Remove the unsigned raw fallback. Relay-side lease state becomes an advisory cache populated only from muxd-signed notices; the relay does not drop/accept input as the authority. Add Origin allowlisting for the trusted client and keep hl-auth as the honest-relay admission gate. Use a leaf-local focused FakeHost fixture derived from relay/tests/relay.test.js because the shared r.2 harness is intentionally sequenced after the trust prong; r.2 child 1 later consolidates it without changing behavior. Tests assert byte-for-byte forwarding, no relay signing key/config, forged/proofless frames reach fake muxd unchanged for endpoint rejection, valid signed response correlation, and every input-producing UI path calls the signer.

title: Signed send-when-idle delegation stored and evaluated by muxd
goal: Replace relay-owned deferred send. The trusted client signs exact text, sessionUuid, condition, notBefore, expiresAt <=24h, maxExecutions=1, intentId, and lease behavior. muxd verifies and durably stores the delegation, evaluates working-to-idle/attention from local session state, acquires/steals only as authorized by the signed body, executes once through the same durable input journal, and returns signed status. Cancel is signed. Relay stores a non-authoritative display mirror and notification hook only. Tests prove relay-triggered early execution is rejected, altered text/condition/expiry fails signature, muxd restart preserves one delivery, duplicate intent returns cached result, cancellation wins, expiry prevents delivery, and two queued items preserve signed FIFO order.
verifier: cd muxd && timeout 180 python -m pytest tests/test_authorized_deferred_input.py -q && cd ../relay && node --test --test-force-exit --test-timeout=20000 tests/deferred-input-mirror.test.js

title: muxd-signed terminal output and client verification before render
goal:
Implement muxdSignedOutputV1. muxd signs every coalesced output frame and authoritative channel/lease/ACL/mutation/snapshot/sb/sbtext/digest/resync response using its identity key, binding instanceId, sessionUuid, streamEpoch, outSeq, previousFrameHash, frameType, request nonce, and payload digest. The trusted client verifies before term.write, reset+snapshot, lease UI, or success UI; gap/tamper/replay marks desynced and requires a signed nonce-bound resync. The relay fans out plaintext signed frames and may inspect/store them. Update backpressure, terminal-model snapshot, sbtext, and divergence paths to preserve signatures and ordering. Tests cross-check Python signatures in JS, reject one-byte payload/header mutations, reject replayed attach checkpoints, detect dropped sequence, require signed resync before render resumes, and prove the relay can still index plaintext.

This signed-plaintext mechanism is the Codex-base resolution of the confidentiality conflict: output remains visible to relay value features, but terminal/control integrity no longer depends on relay honesty. No blind/encrypted-output leaf is included in this campaign.
verifier: timeout 180 python -m pytest muxd/tests/test_signed_output.py -q && node --test --test-force-exit --test-timeout=30000 relay/tests/signed-output-client.test.js

title: Authenticated muxd local control + Ahmed/SYSTEM-only secret ACLs
goal: Replace muxd's loopback-only/no-token trust with a distinct MUX_LOCAL_CONTROL_TOKEN required in the first frame for info, list, open, create, input, kill, owner, bind, and recovery ACL operations. Update muxctl, local probes, integration tests, and scheduled watchdog clients. Keep browser-Origin rejection as defense in depth. Add scripts/harden-muxd-secrets.ps1 to create/verify explicit Ahmed and SYSTEM ACLs for muxd.env, local token, muxd identity key, principal registry, and session ACL state; remove inherited CodexSandboxUsers access; support -WhatIf and a fixture root. The host token is not accepted locally and the local token is not accepted by the relay. Tests prove unauthenticated and wrong-token local create/input perform no side effect, correct token works, tokens are non-interchangeable, and ACL verification fails on an injected sandbox ACE.

title: Scoped relay transport: WSS host auth header, bridge credential, loopback bind
goal: Require wss:// for muxd relay candidates, validate the certificate chain or configured pin, move MUX_HOST_TOKEN from the URL to Authorization: Bearer on /host, redact it from all logs, and rotate it after deployment. Bind Node to 127.0.0.1; add nginx config/tests for public TLS proxying of the trusted client API/ws and /host while closing direct 7682 exposure. Remove isTrustedLocal authorization. Give the desktop bridge a distinct scoped credential for projection push and command lease/ack routes; browser owner cookies cannot call bridge-only routes and bridge credentials cannot open /host or browser ws. Add bounded pre-auth rate/size limits. Deploy scripts validate both sides, drain relay, rotate credentials, and roll back config on failed smoke. Tests use a local TLS server to prove valid cert+header succeeds, plaintext/query token/bad cert/wrong scoped credential fail, and no route succeeds from loopback without its explicit role credential.

title: Desktop bridge verifies client principal proof before every PC-side app command
goal: Amend the app-command queue so the relay stores and leases an opaque signed authorization envelope unchanged. Add a C# verifier for trust-auth-v1 vectors and the ACL-protected PC principal registry. Before transcript/archive reads, rename/title/collection/history mutations, fetchfile, or startmux, both GUI and headless pollers verify signature, principal/key status, global scope, expiry, intent/body digest, replay state, and current projected resource membership. startmux then enters muxd through its signed create path. Missing proof, relay-generated intent, plaintext replayPolicy, or leaseToken alone is rejected and acked failed without side effect. Remove the local-intent minting fallback for remote commands. Tests prove proofless/wrong-scope/revoked/stale/altered commands do nothing, a valid command executes once, exact redelivery is deduped, and current projection membership is required.

title: Three-process trust smoke + staged principalAuthV1 enforcement
goal:
Extend the real relay + real muxd + real ConPTY smoke with a test principal and trusted-client protocol implementation. In audit mode, prove unsigned legacy frames are logged/rejected by the verifier path without changing current rollout state. Provision principal A with drive and principal B with drive, claim a test session, then enable enforce mode. Assert: A signed input echoes; a syntactically valid proofless relay frame gets principal-proof-required and no echo; relay changes one signed byte and muxd rejects; wrong-session replay rejects; A acquires lease, B is denied, B signed-steals, delayed A old-epoch input rejects; revoke B locally and its live channel stops; valid signed output renders, relay-mutated output is rejected by the client; signed deferred input executes once after local idle. Finish by making MUX_AUTHZ_MODE=enforce the production default only after the positive/negative migration checks and documented per-device re-pair checklist pass. No skip path and all processes die in finally.

The smoke also reruns the trust decision-record checker and fails if any residual lacks detect:/accepted:, if the VPS multi-tenancy reason is absent, if the enrollment-bootstrap argument is absent, or if the confidentiality tradeoff is unrecorded.
